about: What the office-hours scene's ending (src/director/data/purpose-arcs.json, constituent-help, and each case's own arc in src/director/data/arc-variants.json) decides on the constituent's case (constituent-cases.ts handleCase): a call made, a caseworker given, the household put first for rent help or a visit asked for is the office taking the case up, which refers it as helping does; a no is the case turned away. Any other ending leaves the case to the office's own call by its deadline. Names only; nothing here is a number the world runs on.
